B2B: BROADER ACCESS, UNCERTAIN INCREMENTALITY | G3-G6
|
|-- Expand: 2018 expectation
|   `-- [S] Wholesale important to a few, not the wider Plus base [a].
|-- Focused compounding: scale within and beyond DTC merchants
|   |-- [S] FY23 B2B GMV doubled, primarily existing merchants [b].
|   |-- [S] Q1 2024: moving DTC/app wholesale workflows to B2B [c].
|   |-- [S] Q3 2024: B2B-only entrants; some try DTC [d].
|   `-- [S] FY24 GMV >140%; still a small GMV portion [e].
|-- Reacceleration: expansion continues
|   |-- [S] FY25 GMV +96%; Q3 2026 +74% [f,h].
|   |-- [S] Q2 2026: native B2B expanded beyond Plus [g].
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026: hardware, electronics, business supplies growing [h].
|
|-- Separate growth sources
|   |-- existing wholesale -[D:data]-> adoption of native B2B [b,c]
|   |-- new B2B-only merchants -[D:claim]-> new addressable verticals [d,h]
|   `-- [I] Reclassification may lift B2B GMV without lifting total GMV.
|
|-- Scale sensitivity: scenario, not a reported estimate
|   |-- [I] Assume B2B = 1-3% of FY24 company GMV.
|   |-- [I] FY25 contribution = assumed share x 96% growth.
|   `-- [I] Result: 0.96-2.88pp, if definitions stay fixed and no overlap.
|       assumed share -[D:mech]-> arithmetic contribution, not causation
|
`-- TAM ambiguity
    |-- [S] Q4 2023: offline + B2B estimated >$450B [b].
    |-- [S] Q3 2024: B2B described as roughly $14B [d].
    `-- [I] Scope/basis not reconciled; do not combine or silently correct.
